caption: The drawing depicts a metallic tankard with a slightly flared rim and a broad base, rendered in grayscale. The tankard has a large, curved handle attached to its right side, featuring a beaded or ridged pattern along the top edge of the handle. At the lower end of the handle, there is a thumb rest or lever projecting outward. The body of the tankard is tapered, broader at the base and narrowing towards the top. The object is centrally positioned within a larger square border. In the bottom right corner of the drawing, there is a smaller inset sketch that shows a front view of the same tankard with its handle upright, emphasizing the design and structure in a simplified form. The background of the drawing is plain, and the overall composition utilizes soft shading to suggest the metallic texture and three-dimensional form of the tankard. The colors in the drawing range from light grays to darker shades, maintaining a monochromatic appearance.
title: Silver Communion Mug
